resources.string: Connect to loom on your PC
Scan the QR code from loom on your PC: Settings › Phone › [Connect phone]. The phone must be on the same Wi‑Fi as the PC, or on Tailscale when outside.
With Tailscale Serve, you can type the address and the code
This is not a loom QR code. Scan the QR code in Settings › Phone of loom on your PC.
Could not scan the QR code. Type the PC address.
Make sure Tailscale is on for this phone, and that the PC and loom are on.
Make sure the phone and the PC are on the same Wi‑Fi, and that the PC and loom are on. If the PC address changed, scan the QR code again.
The PC at this address is not the paired PC. Scan the QR code again in loom on your PC.
Turn on \"Allow from this source\" in Settings.
Type all 8 characters of the code. For a PC that is already connected, leave the code empty.
